result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a loading spinner overlay stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: White circular loading indicator with green progress arc is displayed over the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, obscuring the food photo and suggesting the image never finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image fully loads and dismiss the loader; add fallback image with retry and remove spinner once loading completes.
